avis.texte: This makes my skin feel great in winter after I cleanse my face. Very light cool feeling.

avis.titre: A Staple in My Skincare Routine!!!!!
avis.texte: 10/10 truly!! The best toner I've ever used — it's a must have in my routine or my face is out of whack! An Extremely refreshing follow up after a good cleanse!! Recommend using this product with cotton balls or rounds!

I really enjoy this toner! It feels refreshing on my skin, smells amazing, and gives me a nice boost of hydration without feeling heavy or sticky. I've noticed my skin looks brighter and more balanced since adding it to my routine. Definitely a product I'll keep repurchasing.
Love this toner, it's a bit pricey but definitely my holy grail.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I love Murad products. These products has been a great addition to my skincare routine. I have finally found a product that really works and was able to address the issues that has been a concern for me in the past 4 plus years regarding the uncontrollable breakouts and the dark circles under my eyes. Love, love love these products. Thank you Murad

I love this product so much. Quite frankly I use most of murads line but the Vitamin C line is my favorite. This tone leaves me skin glowing and has improved the overall texture of my skin. My skin is smoother and brighter!

This is my first time using a toner and I wasn't disappointed. It doesn't dry my skin. It does feel refreshing. The scent is not strong and after being consistent on using it my skin felt pretty nice. I'm definitely buying again. I like how I can just use a cotton ball and apply the toner on it to wipe it on my face.

Before this toner I'd use Mario Badescu and those worked for me. I decided to try something different and I am so glad I tried this. I won't go back to the Badescu line. This toner really does help make your face glow. The texture to my skin feels soo much better too. I know this product is pricey for a toner but definitely worth it. I found the one!!
I have used this for over 5 years, I love this and other Murad products. It is definitely a must-have.

Your skin will thank you for this toner. It can be considered pricey compared to other brands, but it's worth being in your bag whether you're traveling or simply using it at home both in the morning and evening. I'll definitely come back to buy more!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This products truly brightens my skin and makes me feel refreshed every morning.

avis.titre: I love this product I'm going to try the other Murad produc.
avis.texte: I spray this in I'm the morning it refresh my skin and gives me a glow

avis.titre: I used to love this product...
avis.texte: I have gotten this product probably 3-4 times and it's always been pretty amazing for my skin. It didn't cause any dryness or irritation. I went back to Ulta recently to buy another one and when I put it on my face, my face burned and not the lowkey tingling sensation that usually occurs. I don't know if they put something new in the formula or my skin just had a reaction but I'm probably going to have to switch my toner now.

Product was easy to apply and used for almost a month and I kept noticing new acne bumps and didn't think it was this product, however, I now realize it is and my acne is out of control and in places that I never got acne before. Should've stopped using it as soon as I noticing the tiny white heads.

I was really excited to try this new toner after I ran out of my Lush Tea Tree Water - I'm one of those folks that can never stick to one product since there are so many options out there! Unfortunately, this was not the one. My main complaint is that I've been breaking out like crazy since starting to use it. Not deep acne, but tons of tiny whiteheads all over. I also found that the product stung slightly upon application, and while I appreciate the citrusy smell, it was too chemically for my liking. Hoping I can return this as it wasn't cheap.

I wanted to love this product since I also have the dark circle corrector and vitamin C brightening serum which have worked beautifully for my skin but once I started using this toner I began to get little bumps all over my cheeks and forehead. After a couple of days I stopped using this toner and bought a different one and my skin started to clear up. I do have somewhat sensitive and oily skin, so I would just be careful with this one for those with sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Definitely going to buy again and again
avis.texte: I've been using this for two weeks now and this stuff is amazing. I was dealing with major cystic acne for 6 months. I'm 29 and never had it before! I even tried curology and was prescribed prescription antibiotics and ointments by my actual doctor. Both still didn't help me at all. Not sure what was causing it, all I know is I changed up my skincare routine with this and it's been amazing. I had acne along my jaw bone and sides of my cheeks. I still have some scaring now, but this has totally been clearing up breakouts! I no longer have painful acne. Even after I wash my face and shower, then use it with a cotton pad there is dirt that comes off so it really helps clear out pores. I spray it on my face and then wipe with the cotton pad. My skin is also glowing! The acne had caused it to have horrible texture and uneven skin tone, but this has made it much softer too. I love it and will definitely keep buying this!

I have combination skin, and have been struggling with a lot of texture on my forehead. I've used this morning and night for about two weeks and have seen SOOOO much improvement in the texture it's unreal!!! I do use about 4-5 sprays directly on my face, rub it in after a few seconds, and follow up with a light moisturizer. Please don't ever stop making this!!
I use it morning and night always. I use it on face and decollate. If I'm not wearing makeup, I sometimes use it three times a day. Very refreshing, and removes oil and things very well.
Love love love this toner!! Hydrating, protecting, improves skin overall, balances PH levels and smells great.

I never leave reviews, only when i truly am amazed. I have used so many products that ended up being duds. I used this once so far and my skin is glowing! Sprayed on to cotton pad instead of my face - instantly glowing and my makeup was flawless. Face felt clean and almost left it feeling tight and rejuvenated. I am a buyer of this for life

I think having a toner with vitamin C is ESSENTIAL to skincare, and Murad's Essential C Toner is the best! I use it every day, morning and night right after cleansing my face and it works miracles over two weeks I have noticed visibly brighter complexion and smoother skin!
I have been using this toner for 3 plus years and have loved the glow I've received using it with the vitamin c face wash.
Introduced to the Murad products via a 6-piece introductory pack. Love it. Very noticeable difference
I use this after I use the cleanser and it leaves my skin fresh clean and smells great
I haven't always used toner as part of my face routine, but since finding this, it's a must. Completely great.

A friend recommended this product. I did absolutely NOTHING for my skin. In fact, after I started using it, I began developing milia around my eyes and nose area. In addition, Ulta refused to accept my return without a receipt, even though I charged it on my Ulta credit card (they claimed there was no way to look up the purchase). I ended up finding the receipt, however I was just over the 90 day purchase (between work and kids, I don't make alot of shopping trips). Ulta refused to refund the purchase price to my Ulta card even WITH the receipt. I was only given half a refund on an Ulta gift card.

I am both satisfied and surprise how well the Murad products work. I start mydaily facial routine with the 1. Age Reform Exfoliating Cleaner; 2. Environmental Shield Essential-C Toner; 3. Rapid Age Spot and Pigment Lightering Serum in (day time only) and 4.Essential C Day Moisturizer. Then twice a week I use Murad Intensive C Radiance Peel. I notice that over the past two months after using the Murad line my skin is beginning to change. My skin pigment is more even and the dark spots are fading.

I bought this toner after they used it on me for a facial and I haven't looked back since. The smell is amazing and it makes my skin feel really soft. My only complaint is the packaging, I don't like that it is a spray.

With-in a week I began to see and feel cystic bumps on my face I hadn't seen in years. The first 2 days felt great and it was promising that my discoloration would be going away soon, I felt super clean and smooth. Maybe it will work better for people without sensitive skin

I'm not blown away by this toner. I got it because it's alcohol-free, but the spray top is really annoying. I usually put toners on a cotton ball, which is better for wiping away impurities, and this just kind of sits on the skin. Either that, or I spray it onto a cotton ball, and it wastes some of the product. I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin, and this toner doesn't make me break out. My breakouts have actually been improving since using this toner, but I'm also using a bunch of other new products, so I can't really tell if this is what's doing it. It definitely balances skin better than no toner though, and I like that it has Vitamin C in it, since I need many products to help fade my post-acne marks and am conscious of environmental/sun damage. I think after I finish the bottle, I'm going to go looking for a new toner, preferably something that is alcohol-free and has Vitamin C in it. I'm still deciding for sure though.
I use it twice a day after cleansing and prior to moisturizing.

I apply this after washing my face and before applying my moisturizer. It makes my skin feel great and it removes any make up from my pores that didn't come off when washing my face. My face feels so clean and freaks after using this.
I use this product right after I cleanse my face and it leaves my face feeling like I just received a deep cleaning.
I have really bad hormonal acne which cases me to have dry skin, I've been singing using this toner for 2 weeks and it feels so refreshing and makes my skin look radiant!!!

avis.titre: I buy it every time I run out of it.
avis.texte: It feels fresh, and takes off the last of the dirt and oil from my face. It's not harsh or irritating in any way.

avis.titre: Not as good as everyone is saying
avis.texte: Everyone keeps commenting "my face looks/feels great." Well, what does that mean exactly? A consultant at Ukta helped me find products to get rid of my redness and broken capillaries in my cheeks. Well, this is not the product to help with those issues. I'm very disappointed that the consultant led me to this product when in fact it has nothing to do with improving redness or broken capillaries in my cheeks and facial area. It does have a nice refreshing citrus smell and does seem to remove the remaining make up left over from washing my face with a facial cleanser; however, this is the only thing that I saw that this product is useful for.
Love this toner! Ive been using it for a couple years. It smells great and I love the convience of a spray. Im always willing to try different products, but I always end up going back to this toner.

I love this toner. I was never someone who used a toner because I didn't see the point in it. However, I picked this one up one day because I figured I should try one out. After using the whole bottle I still didn't think it made much of a difference until I didn't repurchase when I ran put and immediately noticed a difference. I repurchased it and am in love with it. I do like that it is a spray bottle because it is convenient, but I feel like I tend to use more than I need with it. Besides that I LOVE this toner.
I really wanted this product to work on my skin but it irritated it & dried it out. I returned it.

avis.titre: Buy it... you and your skin would love it!
avis.texte: Murad products are great. This toner is like nothing I have tried in the past. Its soothing, non-greasy and non-tacky formula leaves skin feeling and looking amazing. I used it twice a day on my daily beauty routine.
I use this as my step one anytime I don't wear make up, it minimizes my pores which helps to prevent breakouts :)
Use it every morning and night and my fascia list has noticed a difference in my skin
I love how light this is. It smells really good and it doesn't interfere with my moisturizer.

This is my all time favorite product. I spray my face with it and put my Aczone prescription acne medicine over it. It's amazing for evening out skin tone and protecting your skin from heat or cold. I can definitely tell immediately if I haven't used it that day.

I only use this at night. As other reviews have stated, it is slightly stick, but as soon as you apply your moisturizer, that's not a problem. I also spray this on my chest and back after I shower, and I have noticed improvement just in my skin. I really enjoy this product. Oh, it does tingle, so avoid eye area.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use the product mornings and evenings after I wash my face and follow up with a toner and moisturizer. I do notice a change in my eyes when I first apply the product, my eyes look brighter and the feel of the product is very smooth and creamy. It does look a little oily if you apply too much on the eyes but it does go away after it dries and absorbs in the skin. After a few days I did notice a more even out look to my eyes and which gives my face a brighter well rested appearance.

I have couple of small age spots and dark lines under my eyes. The age spots are now little faded away. I am really pleased with this product. I only been using it for about 2 weeks. It makes my face soft. It smells really good.

I used two bottles of this product so far. I've also used the orange one(that one's actually better in my opinion). After I moved to San Francisco, I had trouble with skin dryness due to the windy weather here. It smells great and really moisturizes and soothes my skin. It's gentle and overall an amazing product.

Even though it is little pricy I kept getting this toner. This is perfect for my skin not too dry yet leaves me refreshing tightening results. It works for me as it gradually dimishes my spots and controls oily T-zones in combination skin.

I liked the sound of this product: "Refreshing Toner". I love feeling refreshed! Unfortunately, this leaves a stickiness to my skin that doesn't go away even after it dries. I've used it a few times now, and each time I've had to wipe it off with a wet cloth to get that sticky feeling to go away. I wanted to like this, but I will never buy it again.

avis.titre: A bit pricy but a good product overall
avis.texte: I like this product but it's bit pricey for my budget. If I find something similar I def would not stay faithful to the brand for this item.
I keep going back to Murad's products. My skin just feels better.
The easy application with spray nozzle is awesome! I've always used products of this type that you had to apply with a cotton ball - never really liked that as much.
The entire Essential-C line is wonderful. Refreshing smell. I would not use any other toner on my skin.

This is just what you need after cleansing. It is gentle but feels so refreshing. It tingles just a bit and I feel so refreshed after I use it. I started this product a couple weeks ago after a facial I recieved with Murad Vitamin C product. I love this line my skin looks and feels wonderful.
I use this product both day and evening. It balances my skin and preps it for my serums. It is gentle enough to use twice.

I use this for a whole different reason that what it is supposed to be used for. I use a mineral based make-up and always had trouble with it rubbing off. After speaking to a make-up artist, he said he uses this stuff to set the make-up. Just a few sprays and my make-up stays on all day! I can definately tell when I don't use it as my make-up rubs off on my sleeves.
Since using the toner and moisturiser my skin is more balanced, no more black heads and it feels softer. I had a facial recently and the beautician said my skin was in wonderful condition...
I really like the fresh feeling I get after using the product. Also, my skin looks bright and feels smooth.
I use this product every morning after washing my face. I love the clean feel and fresh scent. I have very sensitive skin and this does not irritate me at all.
I love to spritz this on my face after I wash, with or without moisturizer as a follow-up.
This mist makes my skin feel refreshed and open to soak up the moisturizer I put on afterwards.
This is a great toner that doesn't sting or irritate sensitive skin. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and clean, but not dry!
I've used this product for several years now and have found it to be the best out there. I'm a lifelong fan.
I use this toner every morning after my shower and enjoy the blast of freshness as the mist settles on my skin.
this is the best toner ever. If you have dry skin this toner is for you! I would recommend it for all skin types.

This item has a nice refreshing smell that disappears after it dries. I have oily skin with a few fines lines and uneven skin tone. I was not sure if I should try this product or the clarfying toner but I am glad I picked this one. It has made my skin softer, I also feel this product is gentle but effective.
I have tried different toners and I always go back to this one because it is non irritating, non greasy and leaves my skin feeling clean. I think it's an excellent toner at a great price.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I wanted to try Murad products & this was my first product to purchase when the toner from my 1st time facial at a spa ran out, I decided to tray Essecntial-C from Murad. I like the fact that is a spray and very light & gentle on my skin. It leaves no residue on my cotton ball & will make this part of my daily regimen.
